title: Anonymous niche supplement retailer (GrowthRock shipping study): shipping promo bar (flat)
company: Anonymous niche supplement retailer (GrowthRock shipping study)

change.control: Free shipping not prominently promoted in a sitewide bar.
change.variant: Place free-shipping copy in a promotion bar, one of the subsequent placements tested.

quote: For this brand we actually tried a few different placements of free shipping copy including in a promo bar and still found it made no difference on conversion rate.
notes: Follow-up placement comparison mentioned qualitatively; no per-test counts, dates or point estimate. Do not treat all unspecified placements as separate experiments.
